title: Beyond RAG: Understanding 'Context Graphs' & Why Proactive AI Agents Need Them Now
angle: This explainer decodes 'Context Graphs' – a novel data structure that moves AI agents past reactive information retrieval, empowering them to proactively surface insights and anticipate user needs in complex enterprise environments.
rationale: As RAG hits its limits, builders need to understand the next evolution of intelligent information access for agents, making 'Context Graphs' a timely and critical concept.
